messages:
maria-support: FYI - user says when they applied a second coupon it removed the first one and their credits dropped. Account: acct_98765. Billing history attached below.
ken-engineer: can you paste the exact steps they took? UI flow vs API? any screenshots or request IDs?
maria-support: copy of convo from user: "I added SAVE50 then later tried WELCOME100 and my credit balance became - no, it showed only WELCOME100 applied. I expected both to add up." They were on the dashboard -> Billing -> Apply code.
samir-billing: quick check: our coupon model supports either stacking or replacement depending on coupon settings. Usually coupons have `stackable: true|false`. I'll pull the ledger.
maria-support: ledger snippet from their account at 2026-02-15 13:04 UTC: 
- initial balance: $120
- applied SAVE50 (-$50) => balance $70
- applied WELCOME100 (-$100) => balance shows $-30 (but UI shows only WELCOME100 in active promos)
ken-engineer: can you give me the admin API call they used? maybe the dashboard calls admin/apply-promo and returns a promo_id. If they used the Apply endpoint twice maybe the second overwrote metadata.
maria-support: user shared browser network trace (trimmed):
POST /api/v1/admin/apply_coupon 200
request body: {"account_id":"acct_98765","code":"SAVE50"}
response: {"status":"applied","credits":50,"promo_id":"promo_aaa"}
POST /api/v1/admin/apply_coupon 200
request body: {"account_id":"acct_98765","code":"WELCOME100"}
response: {"status":"applied","credits":100,"promo_id":"promo_bbb"}
UI then shows active promo: WELCOME100 only.
ken-engineer: that looks like both requests returned applied, but UI state might dedupe by promo type or promo slot. I can check the account's active_promos table. Assigning to me to repro locally.
samir-billing: I pulled the promo configs: SAVE50 has stackable=true, WELCOME100 has stackable=false and also has attribute `exclusive_with: ["WELCOME100"]` (oddly self-referential but ok) — default fulfillment logic: if new promo exclusivity conflicts with active non-stackable promos -> replace. That would cause SAVE50 to be removed. We need to confirm why response bodies returned applied in both cases though.
product-ops: pinging product here — customer-facing docs mention "multiple coupons may be combined" but with caveats. We should update text if behavior differs. @maria-support can you get the user's account creation date and whether they were on trial credits? trials sometimes block stacking.
maria-support: account created 2025-11-04, trial granted 2025-11-05 ($100). They used SAVE50 later and still had trial. Could the trial be considered a promo and non-stackable?
samir-billing: ah, trial grants are implemented as a special promo with exclusive flag true. If WELCOME100 is also exclusive, last applied will replace all exclusives. That explains behavior. But user expectation may be reasonable if docs/UX didn't warn.
ken-engineer: repro plan: 1) create test acct, grant trial promo (exclusive), apply SAVE50 (stackable) -> verify DB shows both active promos and credits aggregated; 2) apply WELCOME100 (non-stackable/exclusive) -> verify SAVE50 removed and ledger entries show reversal. I'll attach the SQL queries and request IDs.
maria-support: customer is asking for a manual fix and refund of lost credits while we sort policy. They currently show chargeable balance lower than expected. Can billing issue one-time credit and note internal reason?
samir-billing: we can issue an adjustment. Please escalate with the standard form: account id, amount $110, reason "promo stacking replacement - customer expectation mismatch", and mark as priority P2. I'll process once form submitted.
product-ops: action items: 1) update docs to clarify stacking rules + UX hint when applying competing promos; 2) consider changing apply endpoint to return `replaced_promos` array when replacement occurs; 3) consider adding a confirmation modal when applying a promo that will remove others. Filing an internal ticket.
maria-support: submitted billing adjustment form (link: https://redwood.internal/billing/adjustments/adj-2026-00123) and added customer note. Also sent a short apology and offered immediate $110 credit.
ken-engineer: followed up: found the root cause for the incorrect responses — UI Apply flow treats any 2xx as success without checking `replaced_promos` header from API. Backend actually returned header X-Replaced-Promos: promo_aaa but frontend ignored it. I'll open PR to surface that in UI state and show a toast: "Applying WELCOME100 removed SAVE50".
maria-support: thanks. Customer acknowledged the credit offer and is waiting for confirmation. Marking thread for follow-up.
billing-bot: Adjustment adj-2026-00123 processed by samir-billing at 2026-02-15T15:22:10Z. New balance: $90. Note: manual credit $110 applied.
product-ops: created ticket PROD-9482 to update docs and request UX change. ETA for PR: 2 sprints.
